**Job Overview**

Drive and influence delivery of work within area of responsibility, contributing to operational priorities and ensuring progress against timelines. Will be accountable for delivery outcomes, including quality and timelines, and may have a measurable impact on business results within scope. In addition, will provide oversight on execution by reviewing outputs, guiding approach where required, and addressing gaps to ensure delivery meets expected standards. Take ownership of decisions and deliverables within remit, applying analytical thinking and professional expertise to solve problems and ensure effective outcomes.

Address non‑routine situations and practical challenges by applying judgement to identify solutions or take decisions within scope. Will support effective functioning of the business area by ensuring processes are implemented consistently and outputs meet expected standards. Operate across varied and evolving situations, exercising discretion to respond to changing requirements and priorities, while ensuring reliability, timeliness, and quality in execution within defined scope.

Evaluate business requirements by analyzing complex issues, forming well‑reasoned views, and recommending practical, implementable solutions. Apply structured thinking, analytical rigor, and creativity in approaching work, particularly in situations where standard methodologies may require refinement. Exercise sound professional judgement in interpreting requirements and determining appropriate courses of action, taking into account the broader business context and potential implications.

* 2-5 years of experience in a related role within trade / cash operations management
* Effective verbal and written skills
* Effective communication and analytical skills

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

* Experience performance optimization, refreshing troubleshooting, gateway concepts, and row-level security.
* Ability to apply visualization best practices and translate complex data into clear business insights.

* Hands-on experience querying and validating data in Snowflake.
* Understanding relational data models, data warehousing, ETL/ELT concepts, data quality, and reconciliation.
